title: Labor Day Deals Offer Up to $330 Off Studio Displays and Mac Mini Pre-Order Savings
content:
It's Labor Day weekend, and we're tracking big discounts across a wide variety of Apple and Apple-related products, including some of the best prices of the year on Studio Displays. You can also still get pre-order discounts on the new Mac minis on Amazon.

Note: MacRumors is an affiliate partner with some of these vendors. When you click a link and make a purchase, we may receive a small payment, which helps us keep the site running.

Mac Mini Pre-Orders



  • What's the deal? Take up to $29 off Mac mini pre-orders

  • Where can I get it? Amazon

  • Where can I find the original deal? Right here

$19 OFF
M6 Mac mini 16GB/256GB for $879.99

$29 OFF
M6 Mac mini 16GB/512GB for $1,069.99

$29 OFF
M5 Pro Mac mini 24GB/512GB for $1,669.99


Amazon this week introduced the first cash discounts on Apple's brand new Mac mini, with discounts including two of the M6 models as well as the M5 Pro model. All of these deals are pre-order discounts on the 2026 Mac mini, which officially launches on September 22.

  • What's the deal? Take up to $330 off Apple Studio Displays

  • Where can I find the original deal? Right here

$214 OFF
Studio Display (Nano-Texture/Tilt-Adjustable) for $1,684.88

$330 OFF
Studio Display XDR (Standard/Tilt and Height Adjustable) for $2,969.99


Amazon this week introduced major discounts on the Apple Studio Display and Apple Studio Display XDR, providing up to $330 off these monitors. If you're shopping for the Studio Display, be sure to clip the on-page coupon on Amazon to get the final deal price.

AirTag 2

AirTag 2 (1-Pack) for $24.00

$19 OFF

Apple's AirTag 2 is on sale for $79.99 this week on Amazon, down from $99.00. This deal is on the 4-Pack of the AirTag 2, and it's a new record low price for the accessory, beating the previous low by about $9.
